$description: FeatureCard (platform/patterns/FeatureCard, library wave 8, lane A): its component tokens. The surface, title and description are Card's (card-*); these place the media. Nothing here adds a color.

feature-card-media-bleed-block.$description: Feature card (image): the picture reaches the card's top edge (minus the card's padding).

feature-card-media-bleed-inline.$description: Feature card (image): the picture reaches the card's side edges (minus the card's padding).

feature-card-media-radius.$description: Feature card (image): the picture's top corners, inside the card's corners.

feature-card-horizontal-gap.$description: Feature card (horizontal): the space between the media and the text.

feature-card-horizontal-image-size.$description: Feature card (horizontal): the square picture's side, the icon tile's size (md).
